Plot method for an mvgam_residcor_list

Source: R/mvgam_residcor-class.R
plot.mvgam_residcor_list.Rd

Faceted heatmap panel across the per-group correlation matrices returned by residual_cor(mod, by_group = TRUE) on a hierarchical trend fit. Each panel is drawn as by plot.mvgam_residcor(), one per group, with fill showing the posterior point estimate and an outline on each pair whose interval excludes zero. The facets share colour limits. Panels are then directly comparable. The _global reference matrix is included by default. Drop it with include_global = FALSE.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mvgam_residcor_list'
plot(x, include_global = TRUE, ncol = NULL, rescale = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

An mvgam_residcor_list returned by residual_cor(mod, by_group = TRUE).

include_global

Logical. If TRUE (default), include the _global reference correlation as one panel.

ncol

Optional integer. Number of facet columns; defaults to ceiling(sqrt(n_panels)).

rescale

Logical. By default colour spans [-1, 1], the full range of a correlation. Panels from different fits are then comparable. A correlation of 0.4 looks unlike one of 1. Set TRUE to scale colour to the entries present, for a fit whose correlations are all small. Defaults to FALSE.

...

Unused. Anything passed here is refused.

Value

A ggplot2::ggplot object.

See also

residual_cor(), plot.mvgam_residcor(), plot.mvgam_var_matrix_list().
